shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -c "rg --files app src 2>/dev/null | sort && printf '\\n--- status ---\\n' && git status --short"

/bin/bash -c "cat AGENTS.md && printf '\\n--- package.json ---\\n' && cat package.json && printf '\\n--- next.config.ts ---\\n' && cat next.config.ts && printf '\\n--- app files ---\\n' && for f in app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx app/loading.tsx app/RevenueChart.tsx app/LatestInvoices.tsx app/CardStats.tsx; do printf '\\n--- %s ---\\n' \""'$f"; sed -n '"'1,240p' \""'$f"; done'

/bin/bash -c "printf '%s\\n' '--- cache components migration ---' && sed -n '1,280p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/migrating-to-cache-components.md && printf '\\n--- partial prefetching ---\\n' && sed -n '1,240p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/adopting-partial-prefetching.md"

/bin/bash -c "rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' app node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app | sort && printf '\\n--- root listing ---\\n' && ls -la && printf '\\n--- project styles/test refs ---\\n' && rg -n \"Suspense|loading|dashboard|cacheLife|use cache|fetch\\(\" --glob '"'!node_modules/**'"' ."

/bin/bash -c "sed -n '1,280p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/caching.md && printf '\\n--- fetching data ---\\n' && sed -n '1,300p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/fetching-data.md && printf '\\n--- loading convention ---\\n' && sed -n '1,240p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/loading.md"

/bin/bash -c "git log --oneline -8 -- app package.json next.config.ts && printf '\\n--- tsconfig ---\\n' && cat tsconfig.json && printf '\\n--- eval files ---\\n' && rg --files __agent_eval__ | xargs -r -n1 sh -c 'echo --- "'$0; cat "$0"'"'"

/bin/bash -c "sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/01-directives/use-cache.md && printf '\\n--- caching guide file names ---\\n' && rg --files node_modules/next/dist/docs | rg '/caching\\.md"'$|/fetching-data'"\\.md"'$'"'"

/bin/bash -c "rg --files node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app | rg '(getting-started/(caching|fetching-data)|cache-components|suspense)' | head -80 && printf '\\n--- existing npm scripts and tests ---\\n' && cat package.json && find app -maxdepth 2 -type f -print"
/bin/bash -c 'git status --short && git diff -- tsconfig.json && git diff --check'
/bin/bash -c 'git diff -- app/page.tsx app/loading.tsx && git status --short app/DashboardSkeleton.tsx app/DashboardSkeleton.module.css'

/bin/bash -c "apply_patch <<'PATCH'
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: .gitignore
@@
 node_modules/
+.next/
 __agent_eval__/
*** Delete File: next-env.d.ts
*** End Patch
PATCH

git status --short && git diff --check"
